assessments.rationale: The only usable public hourly NO2 source for the prototype N1 need, and it fits the prototype window exactly. It also has temperature and humidity for N3 prototype (single site). The -200 sentinel is documented and must be recoded. Its licence wording conflicts, and it is a single site in an unidentified city, so it is a method-building source, not a city-representative one. It has no production coverage, which is covered by the internal station source.

overall_rationale: All three must needs have a candidate source, but each is met only with conditions. N1 (must) is covered for prototype by the UCI single-site dataset and for production by the internal station data, which needs EMU access and a fix for the VR-03 stop. N3 (must) is covered for both windows by Open-Meteo, which needs confirmed coordinates and licence checks. N2 (must) is covered only for production by internal traffic counts, which needs Mobility Office access, a station mapping and an adjustment for the 2024 counting change; it is partially met until then. N4 (should) is met with conditions, N5 (could) is unmet under the clinic policy, and N6 (could) is partially met with an unknown licence. The Chicago link is not feasible (blocked host, unknown licence, wrong geography). No must need is unmet, so the overall verdict is feasible with conditions, with N2 the main constraint.
